correctness.rationale: Unique full-edge optimizer by strict convexity and graph automorphisms; exact Walsh spectrum and budget give the root and objective. Binomial concentration proves macroscopic limit; the singular k=0 eigenmode in the first-direction branch leads to the exponential t>1 ratio with verified constant. Rational checker confirms 27 exact Kirchhoff inverse traces, 225 Walsh eigenpairs, and 180 scalar brackets. Tests are finite corroboration, proof applies for every d>=2 and real t>0; limits only at fixed t.

value.rationale: The result classifies exact investment across every finite cube and any positive price of one direction, proving strict retention of all edges at finite d, a sharp asymptotic regime change at t=1, and exponential suppression from the unique singular Walsh mode when t>1. This is a natural network resource-allocation question with an interpretable high-dimensional threshold, not merely a numerical computation or arbitrary finite slice.
